registers.name: GICD_IPRIORITYR<n>E
registers.fullName: Holds the priority of the corresponding interrupt for each extended SPI supported by the GIC.
registers.description: Holds the priority of the corresponding interrupt for each extended SPI supported by the GIC.。GIC Distributor 寄存器

fields.name: Priority_offset_3B
fields.description: IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED 范围内的中断优先级值，字节偏移 3. 优先级值越小，中断优先级越高. 对于配置为不可屏蔽的中断 INTID，此字段为 RES0。
